{{Quote|They say that the Force flows in the sap of forests like these.|[[Thi Xon Yimmon]] visiting [[Toprawa/Legends|Toprawa]]|<ref name="The Last Jedi">[[The Last Jedi (novel)|''The Last Jedi'']]</ref>}}
A '''forest''' was a large woodland area covered with [[Tree/Legends|trees]] and other [[Plant/Legends|vegetation]]. The [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]] was covered in dense woodland.
